mentions.name: Unpark
mentions.description: Unpark is a domain activation engine that instantly generates and deploys a simple AI-generated website to any parked domain, letting domain owners activate idle domains without web development skills.
mentions.problem: The author had 30+ parked domains sitting unused and built this to solve that problem.
mentions.audience: domain hoarders who aren't web developers
mentions.source_excerpt: Unpark - Domain Activation Engine. I built this to solve my own problem of having 30+ parked domains. Instantly generates and deploys a simple AI website to any parked domain. For domain hoarders who aren't web developers.
